audit_phase: Phase 5D — Wildfire / Vegetation-Burn Data Acquisition & Cross-Domain Validation

sources.name: WFIGS Interagency Fire Perimeters (IRWIN)
sources.provider: National Interagency Fire Center (NIFC) / Wildland Fire Interagency Geospatial Services
sources.dataset_type: Authoritative Multi-Agency Wildland Fire Incident Perimeters
sources.circularity_audit: PASSED: Perimeters are mapped by certified wildland fire incident teams using airborne infrared line-scanners (NIROPS), GPS boundary walks, and ICS-209 dispatch logs. 100% independent of satellite active-fire detection algorithms.
sources.access_verification: HTTP 200 via ArcGIS FeatureServer REST API; GeoJSON polygon rings returned with sub-hour polygon mapping timestamps.
sources.temporal_semantics: Contains attr_FireDiscoveryDateTime (ignition), poly_PolygonDateTime (airborne mapping run timestamp), and attr_ContainmentDateTime.

sources.name: EOG Global Gas Flaring Catalog (v2.1)
sources.provider: Earth Observation Group, Payne Institute, Colorado School of Mines / World Bank GFMR
sources.dataset_type: Persistent Industrial Gas Flaring Stack Centroids
sources.circularity_audit: PASSED: Utilizes nighttime M-band dual-Planck blackbody curve fitting (T >= 1600 K), physically distinct from 375m I-band active fire thresholding.

sources.name: NASA FIRMS VIIRS Active Fire Archive (NOAA-20 & Suomi-NPP)
sources.dataset_type: 375m I-Band Thermal Telemetry (VNP14IMGTDL / VJ114IMGTDL Standard Processing)
sources.role: Source of thermal radiant flux and sensor geometry features; requires independent labels.

sources.name: NASA MODIS MCD64A1 / VIIRS VNP64A1 Burned Area Product
sources.provider: NASA LP DAAC / USGS EROS / University of Maryland
sources.circularity_audit: PASSED CORROBORATION: Measures radiometric surface reflectance drops. Proves vegetative biomass combustion, but cannot determine whether the burn was an emergency wildfire, agricultural stubble clearance, or prescribed fuel management.

sources.name: Canadian National Fire Database (CNFDB)
sources.provider: Canadian Forest Service, Natural Resources Canada / CWFIS
sources.access_verification: Direct static ZIP endpoints returned 404 in programmatic HEAD queries; dataset is currently gated behind versioned CWFIS Datamart subdirectories requiring interactive browsing.
